items.q: What does the non-technical vibe coder ship?
items.a: **Hardcoded API keys** in a front end. Hackers find them the next day.

items.q: What does the prompt-casino degenerate do?
items.a: Prompts until something compiles, cannot pass **LeetCode medium**, burns about **$400 a month** after the company capped him at **$29**, and blames a nerfed Opus.
The **slop maintainer**. **40 million weekly downloads**, hundreds of Claude pull requests, **$95** in GitHub Sponsors. Bigger maintainers got acquired by **Shopify**.

items.q: How many pure programmers does he leave?
items.a: The purest has been jobless since **MCP**, calls it **CORBA with worse security**, and is estimated at **fewer than 10,000** left. The joke: stereotypes are **99% accurate about 12% of the time**.

sections.title: The ones left out of the joke

items.q: Who are the last two species?
items.a: A junior who graduated in **2024**, about **six months** after the last entry-level job, and a purest who has been jobless since **MCP** and calls it **CORBA with worse security**.
